items.title: Italy’s WeRoad Lets Korean Superapp NOL Own Its Customers: Exclusive
items.why: A superapp that owns the customer and distributes travel is a model worth tracking for future travel partner deals.
items.summary_ai: WeRoad is entering South Korea through the NOL superapp, which will own the customer relationship rather than buying trips directly.
items.take: A superapp that owns the customer and distributes travel is a model worth tracking for future travel partner deals.
